_note: End of Act I in the lighthouse: Aldo fetches his old oar and opens the ferry himself (plan items 1405, 1406).

say: Aldo stays by the lamp for a long time. Then he climbs up to the loft.
He comes back down with a long oar, grey with dust.
Aldo: My old oar. Nobody else rows my ferry. Not in a storm, not after one.
Aldo: The lake has calmed since you mended the Rifts. I'll take you across to Corvane myself.
Aldo: One last crossing. Then the lake can have the old man back.
Aldo: Meet me at the ferry on the Brindlewick pier when you're ready.
